description: The ASP-19, Lightsaber Training Configuration, Mark IX was a training droid modified after the standard Industrial Automaton ASP-19 battle droid for lightsaber training purposes. The Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader personally designed the modified units for his personal use.
